q: What carbon data do Japanese customers ask of a Neemrana auto supplier?
title: Neemrana auto suppliers: Japanese buyer data
short: Usually Scope 1 and 2 per year, an emission figure per part or per tonne, and a reduction plan. Japanese carmakers are pushing targets down their supplier chains, and listed Japanese companies are moving to SSBJ disclosure, which includes Scope 3. Start with fuel and power invoices.
audience: Auto component makers in the Neemrana Japanese zone and Bhiwadi supplying Japanese OEMs

ul: Annual Scope 1 and 2 with the factors used.
Emissions per part, by allocation of plant totals.
A target and the actions behind it.
Electricity bills, solar generation and open access invoices.
LPG or gas for heat treatment and paint shops.

p: Share plant emissions by machine hours or weight, and use the same method each year so trends mean something.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer traces back to the documents behind it.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
